05/23.03.2023

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 180/2022, registered under Sections 498A/ 323/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 03/ 04 of the D. P. Act, pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Garhwa.
Petitioner happens to be the husband of the complainant.
Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 25.03.2018.
After marriage there was demand of 5 lakhs as dowry by the petitioner.
To enforce the demand, she was tortured and ultimately, she was driven away from her matrimonial home.
After inquiry the learned court below found the prima facie case to be true under sections 498A/ 323/34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3/4 of the D.P.Act.

It was submitted that the learned court below has issued process for appearance of the petitioner under section 204 Cr.P.C.
There is no reasonable apprehension that the petitioner will be taken in custody on his surrender by the learned court below.
The petitioner is directed to surrender before the court below within 2 weeks from the date of Saurav Kumar @ Saurabh Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139354146/
1 receipt of copy of this order and the learned court below, while disposing of his bail application shall follow the guidelines laid down in from Birendra Jha @ Virendra Jha Vs. State of Jharkhand case passed in 2001 (2) J.L.J.R.76 in which direction was given by Jharkhand High Court that in a case where an accused person appears in the trial court after having been served the summons irrespective of the fact that whether the offence alleged was bailable or non bailable, because summons in the first instance has been issued for the appearance of the accused, in normal circumstances, on the day the accused appears in the trial court he should be enlarged on bail by furnishing the bail bond along with the surety bond furnished by the accused.
This Anticipatory bail application is disposed of.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Saurabh Saurav Kumar @ Saurabh Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139354146/
